iconicAnchor.label: Cut-paper collage practice
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The Met documents collage made through cutting, ripping, crumpling, layering, and overlapping colored papers into geometric and organic subjects.

sources.title: P.S. Art 2020: Student Artworks
supports: Cut and torn paper, layered shapes, varied size, overlap, and color are concrete construction signals for paper collage.

sources.title: Romare Bearden: A Centennial Celebration
supports: Colorful cut-paper collage can combine flattened shapes, shifts in scale, found material, and human narrative within a coherent scene.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches cut paper edge, torn edge, layered overlap, cast paper shadow, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/paper-cut-collage/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
